topic: Days until a household reaches its monthly wifi data cap
core_question: A household's internet plan has a 900 GB monthly cap, and they use 25 GB per day. Find how many days until they reach the cap.
answer_summary: the total of 36 days (900 GB cap used at 25 GB per day)
persona: impatient and curt; texting quickly with typos here and there

messages.content: my internet plan has a 900 gig limit and i use 25 gigs a day. how many days til i hit the cap?
